rules.scenario: STRUCTURE VIRALE EN 5 TEMPS : 1) une accroche courte qui surprend, 8 mots maximum ; 2) le contexte en une seule phrase ; 3) la bascule, la phrase la plus forte ; 4) la chute, une image qui marque ; 5) une question ou une injonction finale. Phrases courtes, verbes directs, aucun jargon, aucun chiffre non source. Chaque case se lit seule en moins de 3 secondes.
rules.case: VERTICAL 9:16 COMPOSITION — keep the subject inside the central vertical band, head near the upper third, and leave clean empty space above and below for the caption overlay. One clear focal point, strong depth separation between foreground and background. The artwork stays image-only: absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no speech bubbles. Freeze the action at its most readable instant, mid-movement, with energetic diagonal energy.
rules.character: REFERENCE PORTRAIT — half-body vertical portrait, neutral dark background, soft key light from the side, face fully visible, sharp and unobstructed, shoulders squared to the camera. Keep the exact same lighting setup, the same crop and the same background for every portrait of the same character, so the identity stays perfectly consistent across the sequence.
rules.film: FILM VERTICAL 9:16. Une idee par scene, 2 a 4 secondes. Alterner un plan large et un gros plan. Reserver une scene de transition (detail abstrait, main, objet). Voix off de 12 a 22 mots, ton direct et vivant, phrases courtes. Toujours finir sur une question ou une injonction. Ne jamais repeter un cadrage ni un decor d'une scene a l'autre.
